en: Black‑and‑white real‑photo postcard showing the Olt River valley at Căciulata, with forested hills and the river running between them; a few rooftops are visible among the trees. The caption "Oltul la Căciulata" is printed on the image. The reverse side reads "REPUBLICA POPULARĂ ROMÎNĂ," has a 40‑bani Romanian stamp marked "Posta R.P. ROMÎNĂ" and a cancellation dated 22.VII.1964, publisher Editura Meridiane, and a handwritten Romanian message addressed to Brăila.
